description: Gure Shembola Refugee Camp Water Supply Coverage January 2018 is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by International Rescue Committee Ethiopia. Database developed end of December 2017 for a purpose of Gure Shembola Refugee Camp Water Supply Coverage Analysis in January 2018. Coverage: Ethiopia. The portal files it under the publisher International Rescue Committee Ethiopia. Its tags are geodata, water sanitation and hygiene-wash. It offers 3 resource(s) in SHP. The portal shows 2024-10-07 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
